gaps.name: Topic service messages in the transcript
gaps.whatItIs: Modern clients render centred grey service lines for messageForumTopicCreated, messageForumTopicEdited, messageForumTopicIsClosedToggled and messageForumTopicIsHiddenToggled ("X created topic Y", "X closed the topic").
gaps.whyItMatters: Inside a topic the very first message is always messageForumTopicCreated. Our converter in TGClient.m has no case for it, so every topic opens with a blank or "Message not supported" bubble, and closing/reopening a topic leaves an unexplained empty row.
gaps.whereItGoes: The service-message branch of the content converter in /Users/alexanderhavrysh/Git/iOS/iTgLegacy/src/TGClient.m (around lines 735-805, next to messageChatChangeTitle). TGClient+Forums.m already has the two title strings at lines 36-37 and can be reused.

gaps.name: Enable Topics for a group
gaps.whatItIs: ForumSettingsScreen in the modern app is a single switch on the group info page that converts a supergroup into a forum (upgrading a basic group first if needed) and back.
gaps.whyItMatters: We can browse and manage the topics of a forum somebody else created, but the user can never turn their own group into one. The whole topic feature is unreachable for groups we own.
gaps.whereItGoes: A switch row in the group section of /Users/alexanderhavrysh/Git/iOS/iTgLegacy/src/TGProfileViewController.m, next to the existing "Permissions" row at line 986. The wrapper -setSupergroup:isForum:hasTabs: in TGClient+Forums.h is written and unused; pass hasTabs NO.
tdlib: toggleSupergroupIsForum - wrapped as -setSupergroup:isForum:hasTabs: in TGClient+Forums, no caller

gaps.name: View chat as topics / as messages
gaps.whatItIs: TDLib's view_as_topics flag decides whether tapping a forum opens the topic list or one flat message list; the modern client exposes it as a toggle and honours it on open.
gaps.whyItMatters: We force the topic list whenever isForum is true (AppDelegate.m:304, TGChatListViewController.m:2486), so a forum can never be read as a single stream. On a small phone the flat view is often the faster way through a low-traffic forum, and the user's server-side preference is ignored.
gaps.whereItGoes: Read view_as_topics in the chat dict and branch on it at the two open sites above; add the toggle as a row in TGProfileViewController.m. -setChat:viewAsTopics: in TGClient+Forums.h is already wrapped and has no caller.
tdlib: chat.view_as_topics - not surfaced in the chat dict

gaps.name: Search topics by name
gaps.whatItIs: The modern forum list has a search field that filters topics server-side by name.
gaps.whyItMatters: A busy forum easily runs to dozens of topics; our list only pages 40 at a time with no way to jump to a known one. The 4S scroll through 200 rows is exactly the case search exists for.
gaps.whereItGoes: A UISearchBar as tableHeaderView of /Users/alexanderhavrysh/Git/iOS/iTgLegacy/src/TGTopicsViewController.m, feeding -searchForumTopicsInChat:query:completion: which is already wrapped in TGClient+Forums.h and has no caller.
tdlib: getForumTopics with query - wrapped as -searchForumTopicsInChat:query:completion:, no caller

gaps.name: Locked composer in a closed topic
gaps.whatItIs: When a topic is closed, the modern chat screen replaces the input bar with a "Topic closed" strip (admins get a Reopen button instead).
gaps.whyItMatters: TGChatViewController has no topic awareness at all beyond threadId - no isClosed anywhere in the file. A user types a message into a closed topic, sends it and gets a raw server error with the text lost.
gaps.whereItGoes: Pass isClosed (and isGeneral) from the topic dict when TGTopicsViewController.m:706 pushes the chat, and hide/replace the input bar in /Users/alexanderhavrysh/Git/iOS/iTgLegacy/src/TGChatViewController.m. The reopen action already exists in the topic action sheet.
tdlib: forumTopicInfo.is_closed - already in the row dict, never passed to the chat screen
toggleForumTopicIsClosed - wrapped and used from the topic list

gaps.name: Topic-scoped pinned banner and Unpin All
gaps.whatItIs: Pinned messages in a forum are per topic: the banner at the top of a topic shows that topic's pins, and the overflow offers Unpin All for the topic only.
gaps.whyItMatters: Our pinned banner calls -pinnedMessageForChat: (TGChatViewController.m:2351), so inside a topic it shows some unrelated topic's pinned message. That is actively misleading, and there is no way to clear a topic's pins.
gaps.whereItGoes: Make the banner load in TGChatViewController.m topic-aware, and wire -unpinAllMessagesInForumTopicInChat:topic: (wrapped in TGClient+Forums.h, no caller) into the banner's action sheet.
tdlib: getChatPinnedMessage / searchChatMessages with topic filter - chat-scoped only today

gaps.name: Choosing the topic colour when creating a topic
gaps.whatItIs: ForumCreateTopicScreen offers the six server-allowed icon colours as swatches alongside the name field and the emoji icon picker.
gaps.whyItMatters: Our create flow derives the colour from a hash of the name (-iconColourForName: in TGTopicsViewController.m:1192), so the user cannot pick one and cannot change it later. Colour is the only thing distinguishing rows in our list, since we draw circles rather than emoji glyphs.
gaps.whereItGoes: Replace the UIAlertView name prompt in TGTopicsViewController.m -newTopicPressed (line 1060) with a small compose screen: name field, a row of six swatches from -forumTopicIconColors, and the existing icon action sheet.
tdlib: createForumTopic with icon_color - wrapped, colour currently hashed rather than chosen

gaps.name: Create-topic gating on can_create_topics
gaps.whatItIs: The modern client only shows the new-topic button when the user actually holds can_create_topics (or can_manage_topics), and non-creators cannot edit somebody else's topic.
gaps.whyItMatters: Our plus button and the whole edit/close/delete action sheet are unconditional, so ordinary members in a locked-down forum tap through a full form and only then get a bare CHAT_ADMIN_REQUIRED error.
gaps.whereItGoes: Gate -newTopicPressed and the entries in -topicHeld: in TGTopicsViewController.m on the chat permission dict. Both flags are already read: "createTopics" in TGClient+ChatManagement.m and "can_manage_topics" in the admin-rights key list in TGClient+Groups.m:41.

gaps.name: Per-topic drafts
gaps.whatItIs: Each topic keeps its own draft; the modern topic row shows a red "Draft:" preview and the composer refills when the topic is reopened.
gaps.whyItMatters: Half-written replies in a forum are lost when you back out to the topic list, and nothing on the list reminds you a reply was in progress. Drafts are one of the few things a 2013 client is expected to get right.
gaps.whereItGoes: Surface forumTopic.draft_message in the row dict built by TGClient+Forums.m and render it in the cell in TGTopicsViewController.m; TGChatViewController already passes thread through to -clearDraftInChat:thread: so the send path is mostly there.
tdlib: forumTopic.draft_message - not surfaced in the row dict

gaps.name: Real custom-emoji icons on topic rows
gaps.whatItIs: Every topic carries a custom emoji icon, shown as the glyph on the row and in the picker; only topics with no emoji fall back to the coloured circle.
gaps.whyItMatters: We already let the user pick an icon from getForumTopicDefaultIcons (TGTopicsViewController.m:389) but the list always draws a coloured circle with a letter, so the icon the user chose is invisible everywhere. Topics look identical to each other and to what they looked like before the picker existed.
gaps.whereItGoes: Resolve iconEmojiId to a sticker thumbnail, download it through the existing file plumbing and cache it per row alongside TGTopicFlushAvatarCache in TGTopicsViewController.m. Static WEBP thumbs are fine on a 4S; animated TGS icons must be drawn as a single still frame.
tdlib: getForumTopicDefaultIcons - wrapped and used for the picker only
getCustomEmojiStickers - needed to resolve arbitrary iconEmojiId

gaps.name: Opening an incoming t.me topic link
gaps.whatItIs: Tapping a t.me/c/<chat>/<topic>/<message> link jumps straight into that topic at that message.
gaps.whyItMatters: We can copy a topic link out (-forumTopicLinkInChat: is wired into the action sheet) but cannot follow one in, so links shared inside the forum itself are dead. It is an asymmetry the user notices immediately.
gaps.whereItGoes: Needs the general internal-link router we still lack, plus a topic branch that pushes TGChatViewController with the right threadId. Link taps are handled ad hoc in TGChatViewController.m today.

gaps.name: Forum tab strip above the transcript
gaps.whatItIs: Recent clients pin a horizontally paging strip of topic tabs above the message list (has_forum_tabs / displayForumAsTabs), each tab a live chat history you swipe between.
gaps.whyItMatters: It is the modern default way to move between topics, so its absence is visible to anyone coming from the current app - but the plain topic list covers the same need.
gaps.whereItGoes: Nowhere; keep TGTopicsViewController as the only forum navigation and pass hasTabs NO to toggleSupergroupIsForum.
tdlib: toggleSupergroupIsForum has_forum_tabs - wrapped, deliberately always NO
